## Why This Is Asked
New angle focusing on data-labeling pipeline telemetry with privacy and drift concerns across tenants.

- OTCA telemetry for labeling platforms
- Per-tenant residency and privacy-by-design
- Streaming paths and schema/version management
- Drift detection and alerting

## Code Example
```javascript
// Simple drift alert check
function shouldAlert(prev, curr, epsilon=0.05) {
  return Math.abs(curr - prev) > epsilon;
}
```

- How would you test retention and schema evolution?
